body:
Partners Group stock closed at CHF 621.00 on September 17, 2026 on the SIX, only CHF 8.60 above its 52-week low and with a market capitalization near CHF 16 billion. Partners Group stock also stands out in 2026 with an estimated 7.37 percent dividend yield compared with other SMI constituents.

Partners Group Holding AG stock (ISIN CH0024608827) ended September 17, 2026 at CHF 621.00 on the SIX Swiss Exchange, leaving the asset manager just CHF 8.60 above its 52-week low and implying a market capitalization of CHF 15.997 billion.

As Bloomberg reported on September 18, 2026, Partners Group AG is exploring a deal to shift around EUR 800 million (USD 917 million) of private credit loans into a continuation vehicle, allowing it to hold selected loans from its 2018 and 2020 Private Markets Credit Strategies and several Multi-Asset Credit funds for longer.

According to Bloomberg , the envisaged continuation vehicle would buy loans from existing funds, offering current investors the choice to roll into the new structure or exit, which could smooth portfolio rotations and lock in management fees for longer.

Partners Group stock is currently one of the stronger income plays in the Swiss blue-chip universe: in 2026 the shares are expected to offer an estimated dividend yield of 7.37 percent, the highest among the stocks in the Swiss Market Index according to FactSet data cited by finanzen.ch on September 18, 2026.

In the same midday market snapshot, Partners Group shares were quoted at CHF 625.60, up 0.74 percent on the day and ranking among the top-performing SMI constituents alongside Logitech, ABB, Roche and UBS, as reported by finanzen.ch .

Per recent market data as of September 17, 2026, Partners Group stock closed at CHF 621.00 on the SIX after trading between CHF 612.40 and CHF 625.20 during the session, with the 52-week low at CHF 612.40 and the 52-week high at CHF 1,107.00, implying that the shares are currently much closer to the bottom than to the top of their one-year range.

At the September 17, 2026 closing price of CHF 621.00, the market capitalization of Partners Group Holding AG stood at CHF 15.997 billion, underscoring the group’s status as a major constituent of the Swiss Market Index and a sizeable player in global private markets.

For income-oriented investors, the combination of a share price near the 52-week low and an estimated 2026 dividend yield of 7.37 percent, as highlighted by finanzen.ch , makes Partners Group stock an unusual mix of high yield and private markets exposure compared with other SMI names.

At the same time, the planned EUR 800 million continuation vehicle in private credit described by Bloomberg adds a structural dimension to the story: extending the holding period of loans may stabilize fee streams but also concentrates exposure to selected credit assets, which is a key risk factor investors need to weigh.
